navigation_3_eval.suitability: Navigation 3 (androidx.navigation3) is in early experimental alpha stages and introduces unstable APIs not yet standardized in stable compose-bom 2024.09.02.

navigation_compose_eval.suitability: Stable NavHost is available, but for top-level 5-root tab switching where each root maintains its own state and stack, standard state-driven tab switching with rememberSaveable (backed by Compose Navigation per-tab subgraphs in subsequent feature waves) provides the most deterministic, leak-free, and minimal footprint without backstack thrashing.

root_navigation_strategy: Stateful Root Navigation with rememberSaveable tab state, independent per-root view containers, and back press handling to Discover root before app exit.
ponytail_verdict: Adhere to simplest stable standard: rememberSaveable for current tab state with BackHandler, avoiding unnecessary alpha dependencies.
